data.name: GeoStamp_Name
data.value: Geo Stamp

data.name: GeoStamp_Desc
data.value: Stamp the device's location, and optionally a photo, onto a record.

data.name: value_Name
data.value: Location

data.name: value_Desc
data.value: The column the formatted coordinates are written to.

data.name: latitude_Name
data.value: Latitude

data.name: latitude_Desc
data.value: Optional. A decimal column to receive the latitude as a number.

data.name: longitude_Name
data.value: Longitude

data.name: longitude_Desc
data.value: Optional. A decimal column to receive the longitude as a number.

data.name: coordinatePrecision_Name
data.value: Decimal places

data.name: coordinatePrecision_Desc
data.value: How many decimal places the written coordinates carry. Six is about 0.1 m.

data.name: accuracyThreshold_Name
data.value: Accuracy warning (m)

data.name: accuracyThreshold_Desc
data.value: A fix less accurate than this is still recorded, and labelled as approximate.

data.name: showMap_Name
data.value: Show map

data.name: showMap_Desc
data.value: Show a map thumbnail. This loads a tile from an external service, which makes apps using this component premium.

data.name: tileUrlTemplate_Name
data.value: Map tile URL

data.name: tileUrlTemplate_Desc
data.value: A https tile URL containing {z}, {x} and {y}. Point it at your own tile server to keep requests inside your tenant.

data.name: recordId_Name
data.value: Record id

data.name: recordId_Desc
data.value: Bind to the record's own id column. Only needed to attach a photo, and only where the host does not supply it.

data.name: recordEntity_Name
data.value: Record table

data.name: recordEntity_Desc
data.value: The table's logical name, such as account. Bind to a static value.

data.name: stampCount_Name
data.value: Stamp count

data.name: stampCount_Desc
data.value: Increases on every stamp, so a repeat from the same spot still raises OnChange.

data.name: lastNoteId_Name
data.value: Last note id

data.name: lastNoteId_Desc
data.value: The note the most recent photo was saved to. Empty where the host cannot save one.

data.name: GeoStamp_NoAccess
data.value: You do not have access to this location.

data.name: GeoStamp_Empty
data.value: No location recorded.

data.name: GeoStamp_Stamp
data.value: Record location

data.name: GeoStamp_Locating

data.name: GeoStamp_Photo
data.value: Add photo

data.name: GeoStamp_Accuracy
data.value: Accurate to about {0} m.

data.name: GeoStamp_Vague
data.value: Approximate — accurate to about {0} m only.

data.name: GeoStamp_Denied
data.value: Location permission was refused. Allow location for this app, then try again.

data.name: GeoStamp_Unavailable
data.value: This device cannot report its location.

data.name: GeoStamp_NoGeolocation
data.value: Location is not available on this client. It works in the mobile app and in canvas apps.
